participation.context: Kept the book as it was.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Kept the king, and is in the picture only as the man the cues belong to.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

story.body: You confirmed the part and refused a new line. Tomorrow's reading stayed tomorrow.

participation.context: Read it, and did not go.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let the bill be a title. You did not make it an errand.

title: Read the Rose bill Crack Me

participation.context: Played Gaunt and did not leave early.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the king through the afternoon.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

story.body: You came off the stage with the part and remained in the house until the play was over.

title: Played Gaunt and stayed until the end
